name: io.github.Pepebits/outlook-mcp
title: Outlook Mail
description: Read, search, send and clean up Outlook.com / Hotmail mail through Microsoft Graph.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your own Azure app (client) ID. Leave unset to use the shared app for personal accounts.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: consumers (default), organizations, common or a tenant ID.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only read-only tools.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: auto (default), keychain or file: where the token cache is stored.
